text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Coming from a layman, it might not mean much, but I believe you fought admirably.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "Deepening my knowledge of an unfamiliar world was quite a fruitful experience."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However, it seems to be a far more unruly game than imagined.
It wouldn't be surprising if many people gave up on it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it's an Umamusume plushie, I'd certainly
want them to be widely distributed, but...
It ended in a disappointing result...
